item.title: Blueprint Construction Update
item.description:
Please note that construction schedules are subject to change due to weather, site issues, etc. Reference this MAP to view the impacted construction areas for next week.

Unsure about which is your area? Visit the Blueprint map and enter your address to find out! 

Sump pump installations are offered for a limited time only! Contact us and we’ll get you on the waitlist for your no-obligation assessment!

Reminder: If you have a basement backup (sewer water coming up from your floor drain), please report this to the City by calling 614-645-7102. Please note that crews are working diligently to investigate issues throughout the city, so response will not be immediate. We appreciate your patience and understanding.
